style: Low poly, flat shaded, every object made of a few clean facets, no textures, no text, no UI, no watermark. The attached images are style references only: the first shows the low-poly flat-shaded look and the readable tile grid to keep, the others give colours, mood and the amount of detail per building. Create a new image, do not copy, crop or edit a reference.

frames.coast: A wide establishing view, slightly elevated, of {world}. {era}. {palette}. {light}. Repeating motifs: {motifs}. The feeling: {tone}. {style}
frames.fortress: Game screenshot of a low-poly strategy game, camera high above and pitched 60 degrees down over a square tile grid, the grid visible on the land. {fortress}. {palette}. {light}. Repeating motifs: {motifs}. The feeling in the build phase: {build}. {style}
frames.harbour: The harbour of {world}, seen closer and from a lower angle than the game camera, {time_other}. Piers, boats, the quay buildings, crates and barrels, no people. {palette_other}. Repeating motifs: {motifs}. {style}

directions.name: The toy harbour
directions.world: a painted wooden toy fortress island on a sunlit table, a sheet of teal sea around it, toy ships with striped sails
directions.era: Age of sail merchant harbour with a stone keep and one medieval tower, as a toy maker would build it
directions.palette: Warm saturated toy paint: cream stone, terracotta roofs, bright teal sea, sunny yellow sand, fresh green grass, cherry red and white accents
directions.palette_other: Late afternoon: the cream stone turns gold, the sea a deeper teal, long soft shadows, the paint colours stay saturated
directions.light: Bright noon sun, soft shadows, no haze
directions.motifs: striped sails, crenellations like teeth, barrels and crates, a flag on every tower, pebble beaches, round trees, fat bevels on every block
directions.build: stacking painted blocks on a board game, friendly and quick
directions.battle: A fairground shooting gallery: pop, splash, a ship tips over like a toy, no wreckage stays, no fire
directions.fortress: A toy fortress island: cream stone walls with fat bevels enclose a courtyard with three cannons on wooden carriages, a stone keep with a terracotta roof, two toy ships with striped sails at a small wooden pier, round trees, calm teal sea
directions.materials: Painted wood: every surface a single flat colour with a fat bevel and a slightly lighter top face, bronze cannons on cherry red carriages, canvas sails with red and white stripes
directions.sky: A clear bright blue sky with two or three fat white clouds, the sea a flat sheet of teal, a toy's sky, no haze

directions.name: The lighthouse islands
directions.world: a scatter of small fogged islands in a teal sea that fades to cream at the horizon, a lighthouse fort on the largest, ships that appear out of the haze
directions.era: Age of sail at a remote trading post: a lighthouse, a signal mast, pale wooden piers, a medieval round tower for the keep, pine and gorse rather than palms
directions.palette: Soft but saturated: teal sea fading to cream, pale sand, moss green grass with a visible checker grid, bone white and grey stone, pale driftwood, a red and white lighthouse, lantern orange accents
directions.palette_other: Dawn: the fog glows pink and cream, the lighthouse beam is on, the sea is pale teal, everything soft and bright
directions.light: Soft bright overcast glow, a cream sky, fog banks at the horizon, faint shadows
directions.motifs: the lighthouse, fog banks, gulls, rope, lanterns, pale wooden piers, pine trees, rock shelves at the waterline, the checker grid on the land
directions.build: settling a quiet island, every placement clear against the water, the fog hides nothing on the player's own island
directions.battle: Masts appear out of the fog, the cannon fire lights the mist orange for a moment, then the calm returns
directions.fortress: A fortress on a small fogged island: bone white and grey stone walls, a checker grid on the grass inside, three cannons on the walls, a red and white lighthouse as the keep, a pale pier with two sailing ships, pine trees, fog softening the far edge of the island, teal sea fading to cream at the horizon
directions.materials: Bone white and grey stone, pale driftwood planks, red and white painted lighthouse plaster, rope, cream canvas, dark green pine, a wisp of fog behind the sheet
directions.time_other: at dawn with the lighthouse lit
directions.sky: A cream and pale blue sky, fog on the horizon, the teal sea fading into the fog, gulls, soft and bright, no sun disc

directions.name: The market town at the river mouth
directions.world: a walled market town where a river meets the sea, half-timbered houses packed behind stone walls, orange tile roofs, a round tower with a conical roof, mills and quays, green fields on a grid
directions.era: Late medieval into early age of sail: the first bronze cannons on old stone walls, cogs and barges at the quay, timber frames and tile roofs
directions.palette: Warm and saturated: orange tile roofs, cream plaster, dark timber frames, warm grey stone, blue river and sea, bright green fields and hedges, market cloth in red and blue
directions.palette_other: Golden evening: the roofs glow orange, the river turns gold, windows lit warm, long shadows, the greens go deep
directions.light: Warm late morning sun, soft shadows, clear air
directions.motifs: orange tile roofs, timber frames, round towers with conical roofs, water channels, mills, market cloth, stacked barrels, hedged green fields on a grid
directions.build: raising a town house by house, every house one colour block with a roof, the walls grow around them
directions.battle: A siege from the water: the fight is at the wall and on the river, the town behind the wall keeps going, cannon smoke drifts over the roofs
directions.fortress: A walled market town on a river island: warm grey stone walls enclose a courtyard of half-timbered houses with orange tile roofs, three bronze cannons on the walls, a round tower with a conical roof, a mill, a quay with a cog and a barge, green hedged fields around on the tile grid, the river running to the sea
directions.materials: Warm grey stone with lighter mortar lines, dark timber frames on cream plaster, orange clay tiles, bronze cannons on oak carriages, red and blue market cloth, bright green leaves
directions.sky: A warm blue sky with soft white clouds, the sea a calm blue, a hint of hills on the horizon, storybook clear

directions.name: The shipwright's island
directions.world: a fortified shipyard on a rock, where everything is being built: wooden cranes, slipways, scaffolds, rope walks and a forge, the cannons cast in sight of the walls
directions.era: Age of sail at its busiest, a naval dockyard: oak and iron, bronze guns, the first forge chimneys, so the way to bigger guns is visible but not taken yet
directions.palette: Warm and saturated: honey oak, bronze and brass, rust red bollards, iron grey, sail cream, forge orange, copper green roofs, a deep blue sea, warm grey rock
directions.palette_other: Evening: the forge glows orange, lanterns on the cranes, the sea goes deep blue, the brass catches the last light
directions.light: Warm afternoon sun, long shadows from the cranes, clear air
directions.motifs: wooden cranes and pulleys, slipways, rope coils, scaffolding, stacked timber, stone blocks and iron bars as visible resources, forge glow, copper roofs, brass gun barrels
directions.build: the yard is the game, timber piles, stone blocks and iron bars stack visibly into the guns the player builds
directions.battle: The yard's own guns answer the fleet, sparks and smoke, the forge glow behind, the cranes keep swinging
directions.fortress: A fortified shipyard on a rock island: warm grey stone walls enclose a yard with wooden cranes, a slipway with a half-built hull, stacks of timber, stone blocks and iron bars, a forge with a small chimney, three bronze cannons on the walls, two sailing ships at the quay, the sea deep blue, the land on a tile grid
directions.materials: Honey oak planks, bronze and brass cannon barrels, iron bars, rope coils, cream canvas, warm grey stone blocks, copper green roof plates, forge orange, each a flat colour with clean facets
directions.time_other: in the evening with the forge lit
directions.sky: A warm blue afternoon sky with high thin clouds, the sea deep blue with white caps, a few gulls, clear and bright
